LESSON: WRITING 11.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Writing 11.4.1 Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.4.1 Spelling, part of Strand 11 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Which words do you find difficult to write? 2. How do we learn to spell words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.4.1 Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration is enhanced as the learner plays spelling games with peers; for example,

scramble or scrabble.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving is nurtured as the learner makes words from jumbled up letters, play

spelling games like scrabble or scramble with peers.

• Learning to Learn is inculcated as the learner makes effort to spell words they find difficult to spell.

91

Values:
Responsibility is promoted as learners write examples of different words and play spelling games such as scrabble

while working with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills Education - Effective communication and interpersonal communication is promoted as learners write words

from a dictation by the teacher or from an audio-visual recording.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of proper spelling of words to similar concepts learnt in Kiswahili.
